mcat_description.short: Roof Works covers roofing construction, installation, and fabrication services for industrial, commercial, and residential structures, encompassing metal sheet roofing, clay tile roofing, polycarbonate sheet roofing, PEB roofing, and associated structural work.
mcat_description.long: Roof Works is a construction services and supply category on IndiaMART where sellers offer end-to-end roofing solutions — including material supply, fabrication, and on-site installation — for industrial sheds, warehouses, factories, poultry farms, residential buildings, and commercial structures. The dominant commercial form is metal sheet roofing using GI (galvanised iron), colour-coated PPGI/PPGL sheets, or PEB (Pre-Engineered Building) roofing panels, typically erected over MS structural frames with C/Z purlins. Regional variants include Mangalore clay tile roofing (prominent in Kerala and South India) and polycarbonate/FRP sheet roofing for light-transmission applications such as skylights and canopies. Ancillary works covered include roof waterproofing, flashing, gutters, ridge capping, ventilators, and insulated PUF panel roofing.

market_context: Roof Works in the Indian B2B market encompasses roofing construction services, material supply, and fabrication-erection contracts, with the dominant commercial form being metal sheet roofing (GI corrugated, colour-coated PPGI/PPGL, and PEB panels) for industrial sheds, warehouses, and factories. BIS standards govern key roofing types: IS 12093 covers laying and fixing of GI corrugated sheet roofing, IS 2858 covers Mangalore clay tile roofing, and IS 1346 covers bitumen felt waterproofing — confirming that roofing type diversity is formally recognised in Indian standards. Regional demand is strong in South India (particularly Kerala) for clay tile roofing, while PEB and colour-coated metal sheet roofing dominate pan-India industrial and commercial segments. Polycarbonate and FRP sheet roofing are growing sub-segments for light-transmission applications (skylights, canopies, poultry farms). Sellers in this MCAT typically offer bundled supply-and-erect contracts covering MS structural frame fabrication, purlin supply, roofing sheet fixing, ridge capping, flashing, and gutters. Major roofing sheet brands active in India include JSW Steel, Tata Durashine, Essar, and Tuflite (polycarbonate); roofing work contractors are geographically distributed with clusters in Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala, Maharashtra, and Telangana.
